intro.en: Como si always takes a past subjunctive, whatever the tense of the main verb.

como si.nota: Always with the past or pluperfect subjunctive.

ni que.nota: ¡Ni que fuera tonto!: as if I were stupid!

texto.en:
**Como si** + **past subjunctive** compares with something unreal happening at the same time.

- Habla **como si** lo **supiera** todo. (he does not)
- Me mira **como si estuviera** loco.

**Como si** + **hubiera** + participle compares with something unreal that came before.

- Estás pálido, **como si hubieras visto** un fantasma.

The main verb can be in any tense: habla, hablaba, habló **como si fuera** el dueño. Como si never takes the present subjunctive or the indicative.

Colloquial: **¡Ni que** + past subjunctive**!** ¡Ni que **fuera** gratis!

Two neighbours take the indicative: **parece que** va a llover; **hace como que** no me ve.

frases.es: El nuevo habla como si fuera el jefe.
frases.en: The new guy talks as if he were the boss.

frases.es: Sí, y nos trata como si no supiéramos nada.
frases.en: Yes, and he treats us as if we knew nothing.

frases.es: Ayer me miró como si hubiera visto un fantasma.
frases.en: Yesterday he looked at me as if he had seen a ghost.

frases.es: Y luego siguió trabajando como si nada.
frases.en: And then he carried on working as if nothing had happened.

frases.es: ¡Ni que llevara aquí toda la vida!
frases.en: Anyone would think he'd been here all his life!

frases.es: Parece que no se da cuenta.

pregunta.en: Complete: he talks as if he knew everything.

supiera.en: Como si takes the past subjunctive.

sepa.en: Como si never takes the present subjunctive.

sabe.en: Como si never takes the indicative.

pregunta.en: Complete: you look as if you had seen a ghost.

bloques.frase: Estás pálido, como si ___ visto un fantasma.

hubieras.en: Something earlier and unreal: hubieras plus participle.

hayas.en: Como si does not take haya.

has.en: Como si never takes the indicative.

pregunta.en: «Habla como si fuera rico.» Is he rich?

No, he only talks that way.en: Como si presents it as unreal.

Yes, he is.en: Then you would say habla así porque es rico.

bloques.correcta: No, he only talks that way

pregunta.en: Complete: it seems it's going to rain.

va.en: Parece que gives an impression: indicative.

vaya.en: Only no parece que takes the subjunctive.

bloques.frase: Nos trata como si no supiéramos nada

traduccion.en: He treats us as if we knew nothing.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Describe a person who behaves as if they were something they are not, with examples.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Describe aloud a strange dream or a strange day: Era como si…
